blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements per Zscaler cloud for Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). Zscaler will email a notification to your organization's registered support contacts approximately one week before your cloud is upgraded. To see scheduled maintenance updates for your cloud, visit the Trust Portal.

Deep Tracing in ZDX can provide greater insight into process-level information for a selected user's device. During a Deep Tracing session, information is collected every minute for the web probe, cloud path probe, as well as device statistics to analyze any issues that users may be facing.
See image.
To learn more, see About Deep Tracing.

In the User details page, admins can now flexibly view and sort user information by application. Select one or more applications in the Applications filter drop-down to view user information on the rest of the page.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
The following enhancements are now available for the Users Dashboard.

blocks.heading: Web Probe Errors in the Web Probe Metrics Section

blocks.text: In the Web Probe Metrics section of the Users Dashboard, icons will display in case of any issues. Clicking the icon will display error information for all the graphs in the section.
See image.
To learn more, see Web Probe Errors and About the Users Dashboard.

blocks.heading: Tunnel Information in the Cloud Path Section

blocks.text: In the Cloud Path section of the Users Dashboard, you can now view the flow of traffic through the applicable tunnels as per the configured policies.
See image.
To learn more, see About Tunnel Information in the Cloud Path and About the Users Dashboard.
In the Users Dashboard, select one or more applications in the Applications filter drop-down to view user information in the ZDX Score User Distribution and the Users list.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

blocks.heading: Zoom In/Out Feature for the Applications and Users Dashboards

blocks.text: In the ZDX Score graph in the Applications and Users Dashboards, you can use the plus (+) icon to select a time period to zoom in on for greater detail. The interval chosen in the ZDX Score Over Time graph will be reflected on the rest of the page.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Applications Dashboard and About the Users Dashboard.

You can now monitor application, device, and network performance by using alerts in ZDX for different types of events. Admins can select from various criteria to configure rules that trigger alerts when a preset threshold is reached. Triggered alerts can then be viewed in the ZDX Admin Portal or delivered via email or webhook.
See image.
To learn more, see About Alerts.

blocks.heading: Application Selector for ZDX Score and Page Fetch Time

blocks.text: In the ZDX Dashboard, you can use the application selector for the ZDX Score and the Page Fetch Time to compare multiple applications.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard.
Users can now allow Zscaler Support to securely and remotely log in to the ZDX Admin Portal for a limited period of time to troubleshoot any issues.
To learn more, see Enabling Remote Assistance.

blocks.heading: Command Line View of the Cloud Path Probe

blocks.text: The Command Line View of the Cloud Path probe is now available in the User Overview dashboard. Users can view probe details including the Hop Direction (to egress and destination), Region and Geolocation, Packet Loss (%) and Packets Failed, as well as Latency metrics.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
Users can now select Packet Interval and Packet Timeout configuration options for Cloud Path Probes.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe.

blocks.heading: Single Sign-On (SSO) Access to the Zscaler Client Connector Portal

blocks.text: Users can now directly access the Zscaler Client Connector Portal from the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Admin Portal.
To learn more, see About the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
